## Summary

[Partial] Perform a leak-down test on the engine before installing a new radiator with an integrated sender unit. [t1880]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Perform a leak-down test on the engine to confirm internal gaskets are sealed.
2. Install a new radiator with an integrated sender unit (SC style).
3. [Partial] Connect two brand-new hoses to ensure proper suction and flow.

_Procedure reported by [t1880]._

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Look for a 'micro crack' that may have worsened over time, often leaking only when the engine is hot and under pressure. [t1880]
